raw_result: {"facts": [{"item_id": "e2fc61767b014cd1b2e921833e6bed7b::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "It is the schema.org type used to mark up an individual defined term."}, {"item_id": "e2fc61767b014cd1b2e921833e6bed7b::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "It is applied in the examples to dictionary entries and to an occupation term."}, {"item_id": "a4397b3afda843b19f463cf386873c84::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "If you want to list more than 50,000 URLs, you must create multiple Sitemap files."}, {"item_id": "73d85f36c1eb47aaabe88d76af854647::claim_text", "attribute": "claim_text", "fact_text": "In order to allow web services to function, many standards are required."}, {"item_id": "bcb3d09f86f144d1871d3b202fb0b388::claim_text", "attribute": "claim_text", "fact_text": "Provision is made in the 2.0 standard."}, {"item_id": "5007a4a1d9c04252906d609129a7b256::claim_text", "attribute": "claim_text", "fact_text": "A Sitemap is expected to have URLs from a single host only."}, {"item_id": "ed69730ffd8c4d118a1c87b4024e8237::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "You may compress your Sitemap files using gzip to reduce your bandwidth requirement."}, {"item_id": "ed69730ffd8c4d118a1c87b4024e8237::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "The sitemap file once uncompressed must be no larger than 50MB."}, {"item_id": "2d266947a67941f8a6488c92af0ff2eb::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "It is the set of tags available in the Sitemaps XML format."}, {"item_id": "2d266947a67941f8a6488c92af0ff2eb::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "It is described in this section."}, {"item_id": "7abb0212529a46e694e4a02759085693::claim_text", "attribute": "claim_text", "fact_text": "The SDMX-EDI transmission format for structures and data has been deprecated."}]}
